citations.quote: The New method allocates storage for an object, initializes its instance data in accordance with 14.5.2.2, Initial state of object data

cases.reason: The referenced clauses were read in both editions: §2002:14.5.2.2 is word-identical to §2023:14.6.2.4 (only clause numbers change). Its target §2002:14.5.2.1.2.1 lists the communication section among the data initialized, but that cannot reach an object: §2002:A.1.1 places the communication section in the data division of a source PROGRAM and §2002:10.5.2 SR4 bars it from methods, so object data is working-storage and file connectors as in 2023. 2023's initial-state list ADDS the OPTIONS INITIALIZE fill, dynamic-capacity tables and dynamic-length items (2023-only data, a widening). No debugging line, report or removed form reaches New. Both witnesses run clean at --std 2002.
cases.widening: 2023's initial state adds INITIALIZE-clause fill, dynamic-capacity tables and dynamic-length items, none of which exists in 2002

citations.quote: OCCURS clause (range of values allowed in the index). This item is required
the EC-RANGE-INDEX exception condition is set to exist and the value of the index is undefined
the value of the index is undefined unless the value of the index is specified by the rules of that statement
otherwise the EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT exception condition is set to exist, the execution of the SET statement is unsuccessful, and the content of the receiving operand is unchanged
If the value of the subscript is not a positive integer or is less than one or greater than the highest permissible occurrence number, the EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT exception condition is set to exist

cases.reason: The range rule is the same except that 2023 adds 'unless the value of the index is specified by the rules of that statement' (2002: simply undefined; leaving it unchanged is within both). What is not settled is the evidence: the 2002 SET statement (§2002:14.8.35.3 GR2 a)1. and GR3 b)) makes an index move outside the table unsuccessful with EC-BOUND-SUBSCRIPT, whereas the determination and all four witnesses rely on 2023's 'even if that occurrence is not a valid occurrence within this table'. At --std 2002 the compiler follows 2023 (OVERFLOW=+9223372036854775801; RANGE=EC-RANGE-INDEX). This is kb/Work PB5625 Reading 1 (normative GR2/GR3b against informative §2002:F.2 item 121), already open. Settled by: PB5625 Reading 1. If the normative text governs, the item-101 range is unreachable by SET at 2002, these witnesses are wrong at 2002 and the row needs its own 2002 witness; if F.2 governs, SAME.

CD OUTCD FOR OUTPUT ... 01 CREC with VALUE 'AAAA'): at --std 2002 the compiler refuses it with COBOL1519, whose text is wrong on its face ('an instance definition shall not contain a SCREEN SECTION - it may appear only in a factory or instance definition', for a COMMUNICATION SECTION). needs: a decision on the A.1.1 'source program' reading; if 2002 permits a CD in an instance definition, the refusal is a compiler defect and the row needs its own 2002 witness.
